thread:
maria: Quick heads-up: onboarding Solaris-7B int4. Fast perf but quality regression on long-context QAs — we see token repetition and missing proper nouns after ~350 tokens. suspect either rotary phase drift or a token-id conversion quirk.

dan: Can you share the eval brief?

maria: Ran local smoke: ./eval --model solaris-7b --dtype int4 --prompts long_ctx_1k.txt --max-tokens 1024 --batch 8
metrics fp16->int4: EM 81.6 -> 76.2, Rouge-L 44.0 -> 40.7, p95 latency 195ms -> 72ms.

oliver: Which tokenizer conversion path? hf v2 or v3? we had soft-hyphen issues before.

maria: Used hf-v3 conversion script from tooling. Quick tokenmap diff shows a short window where ids shift by +1 around punctuation and U+00AD.

sylvia: If token IDs shift, rotary positional indexing will misalign after that point. Also int4 kernel autotune may choose a freq_scale != 1.0 causing slight phase mismatch.

dan: Dump the runtime rotary meta and int4 kernel params.

maria: runtime dump: rotary_base=10000 head_dim=64 per_head_scale=true. int4 kernel autotune chose freq_scale=0.989.

oliver: Try two quick experiments: 1) force freq_scale=1.0 for int4 and 2) re-run with a patched tokenmap that preserves soft-hyphen.

maria: Did both: forcing freq_scale=1.0 improved EM to 78.4; patched tokenmap alone -> 79.1. Both together -> 80.7 (close to fp16 81.6). Remaining delta small and mostly in very long contexts.

dan: Sounds like mixed cause: tokenmap off-by-one plus int4 rotary normalization. Next steps: add tokenmap-diff CI for canonical 200 sentences; add runtime flag to pin freq_scale for canary; if residual regressions persist, run short per-head rotary requant calibration.

sylvia: I'll open PR to add the CI check. ops-bot: can we schedule a canary int4 with freq_scale pinned after PR?

ops-bot: deploy:quant-kernels/2026-03-25 14:30 UTC -> Canary queued (2 GPUs) pending PR merge.

maria: Uploading failing prompts and beam logits to /shared/onboard/solaris/analysis. Will run a 1k A/B once canary is up.

dan: Great; add note in onboarding doc: "check soft-hyphen handling and token counts across converter versions".

maria: Done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
